annotations.title: Roof plan as a PDF (solar roof check)

description: The plan behind a solar roof check link as the one-page PDF report the solar roof check page prints, in German, for the person to keep or print: the 3D picture, key figures, the roof from above with its modules, the faces, kWh month by month, self-use with and without battery, the worst shade casters, and a QR code that opens the plan. The PDF comes back inside this answer as an embedded resource (application/pdf, base64); save it as a file. Nothing is stored on the server and no download link is made. An example, not a quote; no prices.

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.
